overview.heading: What is on the Wetherspoons breakfast menu?
overview.body:
The breakfast selection includes cooked plates, Benedict dishes, wraps and simpler choices such as Beans on Toast and Porridge with Honey. [Traditional Breakfast](/breakfast-menu/traditional-breakfast) brings together fried egg, back bacon, Lincolnshire sausage and baked beans. [Vegetarian Breakfast](/breakfast-menu/vegetarian-breakfast) uses Quorn vegetarian sausages alongside egg and beans, while [Vegan Breakfast](/breakfast-menu/vegan-breakfast) includes vegan sausages, beans, hash browns and a roasted flat mushroom.

The Benedict options offer a different format: Eggs Benedict pairs poached eggs and Wiltshire cured ham with an English muffin. Mushroom Benedict uses roasted flat mushrooms, poached eggs, a toasted English muffin and hollandaise sauce. Choose between these styles by the ingredients you actually want, rather than assuming every breakfast is a variation on the same cooked plate.

overview.heading: Wetherspoons breakfast menu prices and value
overview.body:
Typical breakfast prices range from {minPrice} to {maxPrice}, with an average typical price of {avgPrice} across the section. Each pub sets its own prices, so those figures are a guide rather than a promise for your chosen location. Beans on Toast is the highlighted value choice: it offers baked beans on white or malted toast with butter, without the range of components found in a cooked breakfast.

For a bigger appetite, compare Traditional Breakfast with Large Breakfast instead of judging value by price alone. The latter includes two fried eggs, two slices of bacon, two Lincolnshire sausages, beans and three hash browns. A larger plate only represents better value if you want that amount of food.

overview.heading: Which Wetherspoons breakfast size should I choose?
overview.body:
Large Breakfast is the most substantial highlighted option, while wraps and simpler bowls provide different ways to approach the morning meal. Its doubled egg, bacon and sausage components distinguish it from Traditional Breakfast. Breakfast Wrap puts fried egg, bacon, Lincolnshire sausage and a hash brown inside a tortilla, so the main difference is format as well as the combination of ingredients.

Vegetarian Breakfast Wrap is not simply the meat wrap with the bacon removed. It contains egg, Quorn vegetarian sausages, hash browns and cheddar cheese. Porridge with Honey takes a different direction altogether, combining porridge oats with honey. Think first about whether you want a full cooked plate, a filled wrap or a bowl, then compare the relevant choices.

overview.heading: Does Wetherspoons breakfast include a drink?
overview.body:
A drink is not confirmed as included with any breakfast item in this guide. That applies to the cooked breakfasts, wraps, Benedict dishes, Beans on Toast and Porridge with Honey. Before comparing the cost of your morning meal, check whether the local listing describes food alone or a food and drink offer, and which drinks qualify if an offer is shown.

Do not carry assumptions across from other menu sections. Curry Club and Steak Club traditionally have participating-pub offers that often include a drink, but that does not establish the same arrangement for breakfast. If you want a drink with your order, compare the complete basket rather than treating the food price as the total.

overview.heading: Are there seasonal Wetherspoons breakfast specials?
overview.body:
No seasonal or rotating breakfast dishes are confirmed in this guide. The listed selection runs from Traditional Breakfast and Large Breakfast through vegetarian and vegan plates to Benedict dishes, wraps, Beans on Toast and Porridge with Honey. Use those named options as your starting point, rather than expecting an unlisted special or a particular seasonal ingredient.

Check the menu at your chosen pub if a specific dish is the reason for your visit. A local listing is the place to establish what you can order that morning and what it costs there. For a practical fallback, decide on a second choice in the same format, such as Vegetarian Breakfast instead of Vegetarian Breakfast Wrap, while checking the ingredients rather than assuming they match.

timing:
Wetherspoons breakfast is served daily from eight am until twelve noon. There is no separate breakfast club day confirmed in this guide, so plan around the morning serving window rather than a weekly promotion.

If you arrive outside that window, check which menu the pub is serving before choosing a dish. The main menu typically starts in late morning and runs until the kitchen closes, usually around eleven pm. That overlap does not mean breakfast continues beyond noon. For a visit close to the changeover, confirm that the pub is still accepting breakfast orders before settling on a particular item.
deals:
No breakfast meal deal or included drink is confirmed for the items listed here. When checking a local offer, establish whether it covers food plus an eligible drink, which drinks qualify and what the complete order costs. Typical prices vary by pub, so compare the actual local choices rather than relying on a single headline figure.

Curry Club traditionally runs on Thursday and Steak Club on Tuesday at participating pubs, often with a drink included. Those arrangements should not be treated as breakfast offers. For morning value, start with Beans on Toast, the highlighted value choice, then compare it with the cooked breakfast you would otherwise order. Check locally for any current breakfast offer.
calorieGuide:
Porridge with Honey is the highlighted lighter breakfast, while Large Breakfast is the most substantial highlighted choice. Exact calorie figures and a verified numerical range are not provided here, so these descriptions should not replace current nutrition information.

To compare your order with a daily intake target, divide the listed calories by that target rather than judging by plate size alone. Count any drinks, sides or additions separately if they are not included in the dish's nutrition figure. A wrap should not automatically be treated as lower calorie than a plated breakfast: Breakfast Wrap contains egg, bacon, sausage and a hash brown. Check the figures for the particular dish you intend to order.
allergenSummary:
Egg, milk and cereals containing gluten are key allergens to check across these breakfast choices. Eggs feature in the cooked and Benedict dishes; butter and cheddar make milk relevant; bread, muffins, tortillas and oats require checks against the current cereal allergen information. This is not a complete allergen assessment of every ingredient or recipe.

If you have an allergy, check Wetherspoons' own current allergen information and tell staff before ordering. Do not rely on this independent guide alone. Ask how any proposed swap affects the dish and whether shared equipment or preparation areas create a cross-contact risk. Removing a visible ingredient does not establish that the meal is suitable.
dietary:
The breakfast selection contains {vegCount} items tagged vegetarian or vegan, including a specifically labelled Vegan Breakfast. Vegetarian choices include Vegetarian Breakfast, Mushroom Benedict, Beans on Toast, Vegetarian Breakfast Wrap and Porridge with Honey. Use the item's label rather than assuming that a dish without obvious meat is vegan.

For plant-based diners, Vegan Breakfast is the clearest listed starting point, with vegan sausages, beans, hash browns and a roasted flat mushroom. The vegetarian wrap contains egg and cheddar, while Beans on Toast is described with butter and the porridge includes honey. Dietary labels describe the listed dish, not a guarantee of separate preparation. Confirm current ingredients, any changes and preparation arrangements with staff if these affect your choice.
ordering:
You can order breakfast through the Wetherspoon app at your table or at the bar. Select the correct pub in the app, which shows that pub's own prices, and check current availability rather than relying on this guide's typical range. At the bar, ask staff to confirm prices and available dishes, as items can sell out.

Raise questions about substitutions, dietary suitability or allergens before placing the order. Do not assume that a requested change is possible or that it preserves the original dietary label. If your first choice is unavailable, compare the ingredients of an alternative rather than choosing only by its name.
